name: TOCTOU Race Conditions & Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS)
tagline: Never split a balance or permission check from its mutation across an unlocked window—bind check and update into one atomic CAS or SQL conditional predicate.
purpose: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions occur when state validated in step 1 changes before step 2 mutates it; Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) closes the gap in a single indivisible operation.

spark.summary: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions occur when state validated in step 1 changes before step 2 mutates it; Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) closes the gap in a single indivisible operation.
spark.keyTakeaway: To bound blast radius during partial cluster failures, never split a balance or permission check from its mutation across an unlocked window—bind check and update into one atomic CAS or SQL conditional predicate.
spark.byteSummary:
In concurrent services, non-atomic check-then-act logic (`if balance >= amount: balance -= amount`) opens a Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race window. Two threads both observe `balance == $100`, pass the `>= $80` check, and both deduct $80—driving the account to `-$60`.

Hardware Compare-And-Swap (`AtomicInteger.compareAndSet(expected, update)`), database conditional updates (`UPDATE ... WHERE balance >= amount AND version = v`), and Redis Lua scripts eliminate the TOCTOU window by executing validation and mutation as one indivisible atomic step.

Under high contention, CAS retry loops should use bounded exponential backoff + jitter and pair with ABA generational tags (`AtomicStampedReference`) when pointers or reusable values are compared.

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement TOCTOU Race Conditions & Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: To bound blast radius during partial cluster failures, never split a balance or permission check from its mutation across an unlocked window—bind check and update into one atomic CAS or SQL conditional predicate.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

learningJourney.title: Atomic CAS Loop with Bounded Retries
learningJourney.purpose: Implement a thread-safe CAS retry loop with bounded attempts and ABA version counters.

sectionDiagram.title: Atomic CAS Loop with Bounded Retries

cards.label: ABA Prevention
cards.detail: Incrementing a monotonic version counter alongside the value prevents A->B->A false CAS matches.

cards.label: Bounded Retries
cards.detail: Cap CAS retries (e.g., 8 attempts with exponential backoff) so hot keys don't spin CPU at 100%.

cards.label: Explicit Failure
cards.detail: Raise InsufficientFunds immediately on precondition failure instead of retrying.
